decisions.reason: The data format plug-ins extend the firm's core geospatial data integration expertise, have their own web page, and are easy to refine through in-house R&D and standards work, so the firm can readily absorb feedback and improve them.

The building digital twin builds on the firm's geospatial and data integration know-how and its research ties, and it fits the strategic direction, although its newer BIM-oriented knowledge base and its brief web mention make it somewhat less secure.

Authentication and identity delegation sits close to the firm's established security components for GIS platforms, so it can be assimilated and maintained easily, though it may later be merged into the broader identity service.
An open GIS application development framework is central to the firm's strategy of open, extensible components, and its developers and research activity give strong capacity to evolve it.
The identity service for GIS applications was actively promoted at launch and draws directly on the firm's existing platform integration knowledge, making continued development likely.
